title: Enhancing Universal Access to Information in the 2030 Sustainable Development Agenda
summary: The United Nations emphasizes enhancing universal access to information as a key component of the 2030 Sustainable Development Agenda, ensuring inclusivity for all, including people with disabilities.

title: Grand Mosque Authorities Launch Study to Apply Universal Accessibility Standards at Masjid al-Haram
summary: The Grand Mosque authorities have initiated a study to implement universal accessibility standards at Masjid al-Haram. This project focuses on physical design and infrastructure improvements to ensure the sacred site is accessible to all visitors, including those with mobility or sensory impairments.
body:
The Grand Mosque authorities have initiated a study to implement universal accessibility standards at Masjid al-Haram.
